description: This file defines a MatrixDraftStream class and a factory function to create instances for managing draft message streams in a Matrix chat environment, including functions for updating, flushing, stopping, and resetting the stream, with internal logic for sending and editing messages via Matrix API.

classes.name: MatrixDraftStream
classes.description: Type defining the interface for managing a draft message stream in Matrix, including methods for updating, flushing, stopping, resetting, and retrieving state.

methods.name: createMatrixDraftStream
methods.description: Factory function that creates and returns a MatrixDraftStream object with methods to manage draft message lifecycle, including internal logic for sending, editing, and error handling.
